title: Well-posedness of MV-FBSDEs with jumps
subtitle: Research with Chunrong Feng · arXiv preprint
description: Existence, uniqueness and stability for fully coupled McKean–Vlasov forward–backward SDEs with jumps, allowing full-tuple law dependence and infinite jump activity. The results hold on every finite horizon under Lipschitz and monotonicity assumptions.

title: MachineChecked
subtitle: Connecting mathematical papers with Lean proofs
description: A platform for reading mathematical papers alongside their Lean formalisations, with links between claims, proof declarations and reviews of how the two correspond.

title: Silicon-carbide JFET Intel 4004
subtitle: deepJFET · transistor logic to processor architecture
description: Exploring an Intel 4004 implementation using silicon-carbide JFET logic, with device and circuit models, LTspice test benches, Python simulation and processor-level tooling.

title: Advent of FPGA
subtitle: Advent of Code in Hardcaml
description: Advent of Code problems implemented as hardware designs in Hardcaml, exploring cycle-accurate simulation and FPGA-oriented architectures through Jane Street’s Advent of FPGA challenge.
